shared_elements: carved stone surface in low relief
anthropomorphic figure with head and shoulders
incised linear detailing on a body
justification: Both are stone carvings that present a frontal-or-profile humanoid form with round disc-like elements set on the torso/chest area, and both use shallow incised line work over a broad stone field. Beyond that they diverge sharply: A is a crisply cut, densely detailed narrative panel of two overlapping winged figures with elaborately textured feathers and garments, whereas B is a heavily eroded, blocky three-dimensional monolith whose few motifs are faint, isolated and barely legible.
